question: Who among the following mentioned that ‘Collective Responsibility can be achieved only through the instrumentality of the Prime Minister’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr BR Ambedkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr B. R. Ambedkar (14 April 1891 - 6 December 1956):

 
 
• He was a well-known political leader, philosopher, writer, economist, and scholar.
 
• He was also a social reformer who dedicated his life to eradicating untouchability and social inequality in India.
 
• He mentioned that ‘**Collective Responsibility can be achieved only through the instrumentality of the Prime Minister**’.
 
• Chairman of the Drafting Committee which prepared the Constitution of India.
 
• Set up the 'Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha (Outcastes Welfare Association)' which was devoted to spreading education and culture amongst the untouchables.
 
• Leader of the Dalit rights movement and Dalit Buddhist movement.
 
• Books: Annihilation of Caste, The Buddha and His Dhamma, Pakistan or Partition of India, Who Were the Shudras? 
 
• Award: Bharat Ratna (posthumously in 1990)
 
• Resting place: Chaitya Bhoomi, Mumbai 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **C Rajagopalachari:**(1878-1972)

 
 
• C. Rajagopalachari was an Indian lawyer, writer, and independence activist.
 
• He was popular as Rajaji, C.R. and Mootharignar Rajaji.
 
• He was the last Governor-General before India became a republic.
 
• He is remembered for his contribution to the independence struggle as well as his intellectual and administrative prowess.
 
• In 1954, he was honored with India’s highest civilian award, Bharat Ratna.
 
 
 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri's
 
 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri served as 2ND PM of India from June 09, 1964, to January 11, 1966.
 
• He was born on October 2, 1904, in Mughalsarai, UP.
 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri joined the Non-Cooperation Movement at the age of 16 years on the call of Gandhi Ji.
 
• He gave the slogan - Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan, during the 1965 War.
 
• He died on 11 January 1966, after signing the Tashkent agreement to end the Indo-Pak War of 1965.
 
 
 
• Jawahar Lal Nehru:(1889-1964)​
 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister of India.
 
• He is the Prime Minister who has had the longest term in office.
 
• He served as the prime minister of India from 15th August 1947 to 1964.
 
• He is the architect of the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
 
• He was the Prime Minister of India during the Indo-China war in 1962.
 
• He served as the first chairman of the Planning Commission of India.
 
• He was honored with the Bharat Ratna in 1955.
 
• The name Panchayati Raj was given by Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• National Herald is a newspaper started by Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• He is the first prime minister to die in harness.
 
• Shantivan is the cremation ground of Jawaharlal Nehru.
